ios.desc:
Learn real European Portuguese - not Brazilian.

Most language apps teach Brazilian Portuguese, or skip Portugal entirely. Aprender is built from the ground up for the Portuguese actually spoken in Lisbon, Porto and the Algarve - every lesson, every word, every conversation.

-

MOVING TO PORTUGAL? PASS THE CIPLE A2 EXAM

Applying for Portuguese citizenship, a D7 or digital nomad visa, or permanent residency? Aprender includes a dedicated CIPLE track: exam-style reading, writing, listening and speaking practice, timed mock exams, and the vocabulary the exam expects. Track your readiness lesson by lesson.

-

MEET SOFIA, YOUR AI TUTOR

Sofia is your personal Portuguese tutor, available 24/7 for live conversation practice. Real back-and-forth dialogue. Real pronunciation feedback. In real European Portuguese.

She corrects you, encourages you, and keeps you speaking - not just clicking through exercises. Whether you are a complete beginner or brushing up before the move, Sofia adapts to you.

-

395 LESSONS. A1 TO C2. ZERO FILLER.

A clear, structured path from absolute beginner to advanced. 395 lessons, 3,300 words and 45 guided dialogues that build on each other, the way a real language course should. Every lesson ends with a short conversation where you use what you just learned.

The grammar, the slang, the rhythm - all from Portugal, not Brazil.

-

HEAR THE DIFFERENCE IN YOUR PRONUNCIATION

Speech recognition scores your pronunciation instantly and shows you what to fix. European Portuguese sounds nothing like Spanish or Brazilian Portuguese - the vowels drop, the rhythm changes, and most apps teach you the wrong version entirely.

Aprender makes sure you sound like you are from Lisbon, not Sao Paulo.

-

SPACED REPETITION THAT ACTUALLY WORKS

Aprender tracks exactly which words you struggle with and brings them back inside your lessons at the right moment. You type the word before you see it, so you remember it instead of recognizing it.

-

FREE TO START

Create a free account and start your first lesson in under a minute. No card, no catch.

Upgrade to Pro for full access to AI tutor Sofia, every lesson, the CIPLE track, unlimited conversation practice and pronunciation scoring.

-

PERFECT FOR:

- Americans and Canadians moving to or retiring in Portugal
- Anyone preparing for the CIPLE A2 exam, citizenship or residency
- Expats in Lisbon, Porto, Cascais or the Algarve
- Anyone with a Portuguese partner or family
- Travelers who want to talk to loc
